cards.title: Start Chamber
cards.description: A clean white room. A screen on the wall reads: "Diagnostic Test 1: Discover and Combine." A box on the table has a scrambled number panel on its lid. A small chip glints nearby. A message flickers: "Two paths ahead. You'll need what both hold."

discoveries.label: Examine the box on the table

cards.title: Locked Box
cards.description: A small box with a slot on top. It needs something inserted.
cards.flavor_text: Blue cards are things you interact WITH.

cards.title: Key Chip
cards.description: A small chip that looks like it fits into something.
cards.flavor_text: Red cards are things you USE.

cards.title: Click.
cards.description: The box opens. Two paths are revealed. Use the Map to explore both — you'll need what each one holds.

cards.title: Combination Room
cards.description: A room with two tables. On the left table: a device. On the right table: a power cell. A door ahead is shut. The screen reads: "Diagnostic Test 2b: Wrong combinations have consequences."

challenge.description:
A room with two tables. On the left table: a device with many ports. On the right table: a power cell. A door ahead is shut. The screen reads: "Diagnostic Test 2b: Wrong combinations have consequences."

A faded schematic is taped to the wall:
PWR → V+
DAT → I/O
GND → V−
CLK → SYNC
RST → INIT
NULL → ✕ (decoy)

discoveries.label: Take the power cell from the table
Inspect the device on the left table

cards.title: Device
cards.description: A machine with a slot for a power cell.

cards.title: Shut Door
cards.description: A heavy door. It won't budge by hand.

cards.title: Charged Cell
cards.description: The power cell hums with energy after being charged by the device. It feels important.

cards.title: Sequence Room
cards.description: A dark room with a glowing 3×3 grid on the wall. The screen reads: "Diagnostic Test 2a: Memory." A pattern flashes across the grid. Memorize it.

cards.title: Charged.
cards.description: The device powers up the cell. It glows brighter now. You have what you need from this room.

cards.title: Bzzt.
cards.description: You jammed the power cell into the door. It doesn't fit. The cell sparks. "Wrong combination. Time penalty: 30 seconds. Think about what fits where."

cards.title: Hidden Room
cards.description: A room with a large mural on the wall. Abstract digital art — circuits, nodes, flowing data. The screen reads: "Diagnostic Test 3: Not everything is obvious. Search carefully."

cards.title: Access Key
cards.description: A digital key materialized from the grid. It pulses with a faint rhythm.
cards.image_prompt: A futuristic digital key card, glowing circuit patterns etched into translucent surface, pulsing green light, floating in dark space

cards.title: Data Fragment
cards.description: A piece of encrypted data. It reads: dW5sb2Nr

challenge.description: A piece of encrypted data. It reads: cmVib290

cards.image_prompt: A glowing holographic data shard, fractured crystal with encrypted symbols floating around it, neon blue light

cards.title: Code Room
cards.short_description: The final room. A terminal with a text input. Decode and reorder to escape.
cards.description:
The final room. A terminal with a text input. The screen reads: "Diagnostic Test 4: Decode and reorder."

A reference chart on the wall shows:
"Base64 is an encoding format. Use the decoder tool below."

Below it, a color key labels each decoded letter by position:
🟢 1st   ⬜ 2nd   🟣 3rd   🩷 4th   🔴 5th   🔵 6th

The EXIT CODE sequence on the terminal reads:
🟣 🩷 🔴 🔵 ⬜ 🟢

Rearrange the decoded letters in the EXIT CODE color order to find the answer.

challenge.description:

cards.title: Diagnostic complete.
cards.description: All systems operational. The room fills with light. "You are ready, Unit. The real mission begins now."
